name: Shahad
traditionalUses: Mixed with herb powders to take them
kitchenUse: A teaspoon on its own or mixed with ginger juice or black pepper. Add to drinks only once they are warm, not hot.

typicalUse.note: Classical texts advise against heating honey or mixing it with equal amounts of ghee.

cautions.note: Never give honey to babies under 1 year old (risk of infant botulism).
Honey is sugar; count it in a diabetic diet.

evidence.summary: Reviews suggest honey can ease cough in children over 1 year at least as well as some common cough remedies.
